title: Literature Review: Cognitive Ergonomics in Digital Reading
content:
### Core Hypotheses

Reading velocity in non-glare digital environments increases by **14%** when using warm background temperatures (approx 4500K color temperature equivalent).

> "A quiet workspace allows cognitive synthesis to occur naturally, without premature crystallization of ideas."

#### Key Observations:
- Line length should strictly adhere to **50–75 characters per line** for sustained cognitive stamina.
- Generous line height (`1.65–1.75`) reduces ocular jumping across dense paragraphs.
- Tag hierarchies work best when descriptive rather than categorical.

title: Architectural Principles for Personal Knowledge Systems
content:

> "The value of a knowledge system is not in its size but in the connections between its parts."

title: Bread Baking: 78% Hydration Sourdough Schedule
content:
### Process
1. Autolyse 45m with warm water (28°C)
2. 4 stretch-and-folds spaced 30m apart
3. Bulk fermentation 4-5 hours at room temp
4. Pre-shape and bench rest 20m
5. Final shape and 14hr cold retardation in fridge

The long cold retard brings forward complex lactobacillus notes and a more open crumb structure.

title: Graph Data Structures: BFS & DFS Revision
content:
## Breadth-First Search (BFS)
- Uses a **queue** (FIFO)
- Explores neighbors level by level
- Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V)

## Depth-First Search (DFS)
- Uses a **stack** (LIFO) or recursion
- Explores as deep as possible before backtracking
- Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V)

### Connected Components
Run DFS/BFS from each unvisited vertex to find all components.
